sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Customer invoices, receipts and the import log of module receivables.
Owned by Accounts Receivable. No other service writes to it; they ask its owner through /api/v1 or read posted events.

Every table carries created_at / created_by / updated_at / updated_by / version_no; audit triggers copy each change into audit_compliance.audit_event, and version triggers increment version_no for optimistic locking.

rows: One row per imported outbox event with its result.

sections.title: Guard triggers
rows: Only a DRAFT customer invoice can be deleted - void it instead
A new customer invoice must be DRAFT
The receivable account must be an ASSET posting account of the entity
A customer invoice can only be changed while it is DRAFT
Customer invoices move DRAFT -> POSTED -> PART_PAID -> PAID (VOID while DRAFT)
Number, entity and source of a customer invoice cannot be changed
The gross amount cannot drop below what was received
The invoice lines (amount + tax) must add up to the gross amount
Invoice lines can only be removed while the invoice is DRAFT
Lines can only be added to a DRAFT customer invoice
The line account must be an active posting account of the invoice entity
Invoice lines can only be changed while the invoice is DRAFT
Receipts are never deleted - reverse them
A new receipt is PENDING or CLEARED
Receipts can only be recorded against a POSTED or PART_PAID invoice
Receipts go into an ACTIVE bank account
Receipts would exceed the invoice gross amount
Invoice, amount, reference and bank account of a receipt are fixed
sections.intro: Business rules the database enforces on its own.
